notes:
- Lead: Aisha (AE). SE: Carlos. CSM tentatively assigned: Elena.
- Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS focused on 2nd/3rd-party integrations (B2B). Strong need to keep telemetry & transcripts in customer-controlled network for regulated accounts.
- Evaluation history:
  * 2026-01-12: initial intro call — tried hosted API quickstart, liked latency and dev DX.
  * 2026-01-25: hosted API POC (30-day) — validated basic QA/summarization prompts, cost estimates higher than target at scale.
  * 2026-02-10: technical deep-dive w/ SE — discussed batching, kv-cache, and quantization tradeoffs.

- Technical requirements summary:
  * Workloads: real-time support-agent + nightly embeddings index refresh; some reranking for SERP.
  * Latency SLO: 150ms p95 for chat path at 100 concurrent sessions. Throughput target: 100 req/s sustained, burst to 400 req/s.
  * Model preferences: pref open Llama-family quantized variants for cost control; fallback to larger model hosted variants for complex queries.
  * Routing needs: region-aware routing (NA/ EU), automated fallback policy when Dedicated capacity constrained.
  * Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to commit for discount if commit covers predictable traffic spikes.
- Security & procurement checklist items outstanding:
  * SOC2 report and letter of attestation (requested).
  * DPA redlines (data residency + subprocessors list) — legal flagged EU residency for several enterprise customers.
  * KMS integration and customer-managed keys — security team wants HSM/KMS flow documented.
  * Network onboarding: peering, private IPs, firewall rules, ingress/egress audit logs.
  * SLA specifics: 99.95% uptime target requested; credits formula needs to be clarified.
- Quotes / Pricing: Redwood provided three commit options: (A) $120k/yr reserved (baseline) (B) $200k/yr reserved + burst (recommended) (C) $300k/yr enterprise with extended support and longer retention. Finance leaning to B.
- Legal redlines summary:
  * Indemnity: limit to lesser of 2x fees or $2M — Redwood proposing higher cap; negotiation ongoing.
  * Termination for convenience notice period: customer requested 30 days; Redwood proposed 90 days for Dedicated.
  * Audit rights: customer requires annual audit; Redwood proposed scope-limited review.
  * Data residency: need explicit clause to keep EU customer data within EU Dedicated cluster; Redwood proposed carveouts for backups/diagnostics.
- Onboarding plan (post MSA sign):
  * Week 0: contract sign + SOW.
  * Week 1: security questionnaire + SOC2 handoff + KMS onboarding plan.
  * Week 2: infra set up (VPC peering, firewall rules), test traffic.
  * Week 3: performance tuning, batch config, prefix cache set.
  * Week 4: go-live for pilot customers; SRE runbook handoff and Slack channel.
